newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria tenders to buy 26,000 t white/raw sugar.
newsitem.headline: Syria tenders to buy 26,000 t white/raw sugar.

text.p: Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foostuffs (GEZA) has issued an international tender to buy 13,000 tonnes of white sugar and 13,000 tonnes of raws, a GEZA spokesman said on saturday.
He told reuters that shipment of both quantities should be made during october and november.
The GEZA official said that September 25 was set as final date to receive price offers. Confirmation would be made on September 26.

On September Geza 6 said it had bought 13,000 tonnes of raw sugar for October delivery and cancelled the purchase of 13,000 tonnes of raws and 26,000 tonnes of white sugar which were contained in the same tender issued on August 29.
